## Summary

Describe the change and its user impact.

## Motivation

Link the issue, defect, or documented requirement.

## Verification

List every command and manual check you ran.

## Review Checklist

- [ ] I used the affected repository's documented checks.
- [ ] I added tests for new behavior and fixed defects.
- [ ] I checked invalid and untrusted inputs.
- [ ] I preserved documented public contracts.
- [ ] I excluded secrets and private implementation details.
- [ ] I updated user-facing documentation and release notes.
- [ ] I kept metadata accurate and avoided keyword stuffing.
- [ ] I signed every commit under the DCO.
- [ ] A person other than the author will review this change.
